"Perspectiva: Puro 3D para el modo Battle Royale, diseñado con una optimización estricta para garantizar 60 FPS estables en dispositivos móviles sin sobrecalentar el procesador ni sufrir lag.
​Salud Base del Jugador: 1000 HP (estándar fijo para equilibrar todo el daño del juego).
​2. Estructura de la Partida y Participantes
​Formato: Partidas rápidas de Battle Royale en entorno 3D.
​Jugadores: 30 jugadores reales por partida, rellenados con bots inteligentes para mantener la acción fluida y constante.
​3. Mecánicas del Caos y Castigos Ambientales
​Anti-Camper Universal (\"Las Palomas Cósmicas\"): Si un jugador intenta subir a zonas de altura no autorizadas o romper los límites del mapa, descienden palomas gigantes desde el cielo para eliminarlo instantáneamente.
​El Meteorito de la Humillación: Un mini meteorito cae aleatoriamente en el mapa y le quita solo 5 HP al jugador impactado, activando automáticamente un mensaje en el chat global de la partida: «A [nombre del jugador] le cayó un meteorito, qué pena, terrible...».  
​El Apocalipsis Avícola (Sistema de Justicia de los Pollos):
​Los pollos están ocultos por el mapa cumpliendo funciones de jueceo. Si un jugador masacra a 10 pollos, se desata la invasión avícola mundial.  
​Una legión de pollos inmortales persigue al infractor usando teletransportación cuántica fuera de su campo de visión, quitándole 2 HP por picotazo para arruinarle la puntería y estorbarlo en medio de los tiroteos.  
​Anuncio oficial en el chat: «A [jugador] lo funaron los pollos por hate».  
​4. Sistema de Skins y Personajes
​El Pana Miguel (\"El pana de siempre\"):
​Skin Normal: Un gatito tierno de 1.02 m y 12 kg, con pelaje realista en píxel art adaptado al 3D, traje táctico completo (sin guantes puestos por defecto), cola animada con movimiento, y una personalidad tranquila, leal y curiosa.  
​Skin Especial (Con Guantes - Furia Gatuna): Al equipar los guantes de combate, Miguel cambia a su variante especial, manteniendo la compatibilidad visual con las animaciones de ataque rápido cuerpo a cuerpo. Funciona como compañero fiel que te acompaña en la aventura o en la guerra.  
​5. El Catálogo Completo del Arsenal y Balance de Daño (Ajustado a 1000 HP)
​🌟 Las 5 Armas Míticas Definitivas
​Furia de Garras: 🐾🔥 Zarpazos y ataques corporales ultra rápidos con garras mecánicas.
​Bate Bonk 🏏🐕 («Le perteneció a Cheems alguna vez... (nostalgia porque falleció)»):
​Daño base: 78 por golpe.
​Velocidad de ataque: 1 ataque por segundo.
​Efecto especial: Aturde por 1.5 segundos, permitiendo acorralar rivales en las esquinas y dejarlos inmovilizados.
​Ataque especial (\"Palazo Cheems Gigachat\"): Manda a volar al enemigo por los aires quitando 128 de vida.
​Cañón de Memes Añejos 🗿 («Tira los mejores memes del siglo (el etesech, el Pepe XD y esas vainas)»):
​Daño base: 80 por impacto directo.
​Daño en área: 1 metro a la redonda.
​Ataque especial (\"Láser Nostálgico\"): Un rayo láser multicolor que mete 100 de daño inicial y deja un rastro activo por 10 segundos, quemando 50 de daño por segundo si el rival se queda en el área.
​Chancla Divina / Latina 🩴:
​Daño base: 80 por impacto.
​Velocidad de ataque: 0.4 segundos.
​Mecánica especial: Funciona como un búmeran cuántico guiado por la ley materna que viaja hasta 50 metros y regresa de inmediato a la mano.
​Ataque especial (\"¡Perdiste el año! 💀\"): Un combo de chanclazos hiper-rápidos que descuenta 300 de vida de un solo golpe.
​El Lanza-Chismes 👵🔥:
​Mecánica: Un lanzallamas artesanal que lleva amarrada en la punta a doña Gladys, la vecina chismosa, escupiendo fuego y cotilleo continuo (daño continuo de fuego).
​Ataque especial: Doña Gladys grita un chisme a todo pulmón generando una explosión de 280 de daño en área con subtítulos flotantes de drama barriobajero.
​🔫 Pistolas y Armas Cortas
​Pio-Pio Glock / Pistola de Billetes de Monopoly: Daño de 15 a 20. Armas de emergencia al caer del paracaídas.
​M1911 / Beretta 92FS / Glock 17: Daño de 35. Precisión y cadencia equilibradas para empezar.
​Desert Eagle / .44 Magnum: Daño de 85. Alto impacto por bala, pero cadencia lenta y retroceso fuerte.
​💨 Subfusiles (SMG)
​Uzi / MP5 / TEC-9 / P90 / KRISS Vector / HK MP7: Daño de 25 a 30 por bala con cadencias de disparo extremadamente altas para fundir enemigos de cerca.
​💥 Escopetas
​Remington 870 / Doble Cañón / Benelli M4 / SPAS-12: Daño masivo de 120 a 150 a corta distancia si impactan todos los perdigones.
​AA-12 (Automática): Daño de 75 por escopetazo con fuego continuo para presionar pasillos.
​🎯 Rifles de Asalto y Combate
​AK-47 / M4A1 / SCAR-H / FAL / G36 / M16A4 / FAMAS / Galil ACE: Daño de 45 a 55 por impacto. El equilibrio perfecto para el combate en terrenos abiertos.
​🔭 Francotiradores y Rifles de Precisión
​AWM / Barrett M82 / Mosin-Nagant / SVD / VSS Vintorez: Daño crítico en la cabeza de 300 a 400 (letales) y 200 al cuerpo. Exigen puntería milimétrica.
​💣 Armas Pesadas y Lanzadores
​RPG-7 / Javelin / M79 (Lanzagranadas): Daño de 350 en área con explosión masiva.
​Minigun / M249 SAW / M60 / PKM: Daño de 40 por bala con fuego sostenido masivo, a cambio de reducir la movilidad del personaje al cargarlas.
​🗡️ Armas de Melé (Cuerpo a cuerpo reales)
​Bate de béisbol, Palanca, Cuchillo de combate, Katana, Mazo: Daño variable entre 40 y 90, ideales para remates sigilosos o destrucción del entorno sin gastar munición.                                   .                                                                    MAPAS:. Mapa 1: \"La Zona de la Erupción\" (Volcánico)
​Zonas principales:
​La Ciudad: Calles, edificios, tejados y zonas urbanas para buscar armas y armar emboscadas. Incluye la zona del reactor nuclear.  
​El Pueblo Rural: Zona abierta y campestre para evitar el caos de la ciudad.  
​La Cordillera: Montañas y pasos estrechos con desniveles para conseguir posiciones elevadas, aunque peligrosas si te quedas encerrado.  
​El Volcán: La zona de muerte ambiental.  
​Mecánica de amenaza: A los 2 minutos de partida, el volcán entra en erupción masiva. Caen rocas ardientes del cielo que impactan el terreno creando cráteres, y ríos de lava se extienden por todo el mapa obligando a los 50 participantes a moverse sin parar hasta que solo quede uno.  
​2. Mapa 2: \"El Posapocalipsis\" (Versión Alternativa)
​Ambientación: Es exactamente el mismo mapa anterior pero en su versión destruida y arrasada tras el fin del mundo.  
​Zonas y novedades: La ciudad y el pueblo rural están en ruinas con edificios derrumbados y escombros que cambian las rutas de combate. Cuenta con nuevos lugares explorables, como un búnker en la cordillera dentro de la montaña con habitaciones y pasillos ocultos.  
​Mecánica de amenaza: Una implacable tormenta de ceniza que avanza desde los bordes del mapa hacia el centro, cerrando el terreno y obligando a los supervivientes a enfrentarse.  
​3. Mapa 3: \"Neón Ciber-Barrio\" (Cyberpunk / Los Leus)
​Ambientación: Un mundo cyberpunk distópico de callejones estrechos e iluminados por letreros de neón (los famosos \"leus\") que han empezado a pudrirse por el abandono.  
​Mecánica de amenaza: Los generadores colapsan y liberan un humo venenoso y tóxico proveniente de los leus podridos. La exploración se vuelve aterradora y la única forma temporal de sobrevivir en las zonas afectadas es encontrando máscaras de gas antiguas regadas por los callejones antes de que la contaminación te mande al lobby.
"

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {

function baseHeight(x,z) {

}

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a playable, mobile-first 3D Battle Royale browser game from the user's detailed Spanish design document for "MEME-SHOTER" in the otherwise empty repo.

## Requirements
- Pure 3D Battle Royale, strictly optimized for stable 60 FPS on mobile without overheating or lag.
- 30 players per match (real players filled with intelligent bots), 1000 base HP.
- Anti-camper "Palomas Cósmicas" instantly eliminate players in unauthorized heights/out of bounds.
- "Meteorito de la Humillación": random mini-meteor, only 5 HP damage, exact global chat message: «A [nombre] le cayó un meteorito, qué pena, terrible...».
- "Apocalipsis Avícola": 10 chicken kills triggers immortal teleporting chickens (2 HP pecks) and chat: «A [jugador] lo funaron los pollos por hate».
- Miguel cat skin (1.02 m, 12 kg, tactical vest, no gloves default, animated tail) plus gloves "Furia Gatuna" variant.
- Full weapon catalog with specified damage values and specials, calibrated to 1000 HP.
- Three maps: Eruption volcano (2-minute eruption, lava), Post-apocalypse (ruined map + bunker, ash storm), Neon Cyber-Barrio (toxic smoke, gas masks).
- Spanish UI and exact meme/chat wording where specified.

## Decisions
- Built as a Vite + Three.js single-page app using procedural low-poly geometry, merged/instanced meshes, no shadows, capped pixel ratio, pooled effects, and adaptive resolution.
- Implemented all 5 mythic weapons, categories, specials, loot, bots, hazards, 3 map variants, skins, minimap, killfeed/chat, pause/end screens, and touch controls.
- Mobile detection via coarse pointer/maxTouchPoints; desktop pointer lock; synthesized gameplay without external art assets.
- Added debug hook `window.__game` in `src/main.js` for testing.
- Game flow: menu → loading → parachute drop → battle → end screen; restart/menu callbacks reuse a single WebGLRenderer.

## Work State
### Completed
- Project scaffolding, Vite config, all game modules, menu/HUD/end-screen markup and styling.
- Procedural world with terrain, city, village, cordillera, volcano, bunker, neon signs, loot/chicken spots, weather, collision, raycasting.
- Player controller, 29 bots with AI/combat, weapons/specials, hazards (meteors, pigeons, chickens, zone/lava/ash/toxic), pickups, effects, minimap.
- Build succeeds (`npm run build`); menu and game render in Playwright; major merge-geometry error fixed.
- Initial visual/UX pass started: brighter sky shader with sun glow, stars for neon map, brighter fog/lighting/terrain, roads, vegetation/rocks, landmark-based spawn, debug hook.

### Active
- Testing and polishing visuals/gameplay. Last edit changed player spawn to landmark-based (`findSpawn(48, 92, null, 0, lm)`), but `findSpawn` has not yet been updated to accept a `center` parameter, so this currently breaks spawning.
- Menu/HUD CSS fixes still pending: map card text alignment, horizontal overflow, drop-banner overlap.
- Need to verify game after recent world/spawn edits and check HP loss cause (player had 860 HP ~11s after landing).

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update `Game.findSpawn` to accept a center landmark and return `{x,z,yaw}`; ensure bots still spawn across map.
2. Reduce third-person camera distances (planned: normal ~3.0, aim ~1.9, drop ~5.8) and FOV for better character presence.
3. Fix CSS: `.menu-screen { overflow-x:hidden; }`, `.map-card { text-align:left; }`, move `.drop-info` down or hide overlapping event banner.
4. Add mythic/arsenal filler panel to menu to use empty space.
5. Rebuild, reload Playwright, click Play, verify landing, combat, HUD, pickups, hazard events, and console errors.
6. Investigate early HP loss via `window.__game.player.lastDamage`.
7. Test all three maps and mobile viewport; verify 60 FPS/adaptive quality.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/src/Game.js`: main orchestrator, spawn/combat/camera/HUD/end logic.
- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/src/world/World.js`: terrain, maps, city/village/volcano, roads/trees, sky, collisions.
- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/src/systems/Hazards.js`: chickens, meteors, pigeons, zone/lava/toxic, storm wall.

- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/src/ui/HUD.js`: HUD, chat, killfeed, minimap, damage floats.
- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/src/ui/Menu.js`: map/skin selection and 3D preview.
- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/src/core/Input.js`: keyboard/mouse/touch input.

## Objective
- Build a playable, mobile-first 3D Battle Royale browser game from the user's Spanish design document for "MEME-SHOTER" in the otherwise empty repo.

## Requirements
- Pure 3D Battle Royale, strictly optimized for stable 60 FPS on mobile without overheating or lag.
- 30 players per match (real players filled with intelligent bots), 1000 base HP.
- Anti-camper "Palomas Cósmicas" instantly eliminate players in unauthorized heights/out of bounds.
- "Meteorito de la Humillación": random mini-meteor, only 5 HP damage, exact global chat message: «A [nombre] le cayó un meteorito, qué pena, terrible...».
- "Apocalipsis Avícola": 10 chicken kills triggers immortal teleporting chickens (2 HP pecks) and chat: «A [jugador] lo funaron los pollos por hate».
- Miguel cat skin (1.02 m, 12 kg, tactical vest, no gloves default, animated tail) plus gloves "Furia Gatuna" variant.
- Full weapon catalog with specified damage values and specials, calibrated to 1000 HP.
- Three maps: Eruption volcano (2-minute eruption, lava), Post-apocalypse (ruined map + bunker, ash storm), Neon Cyber-Barrio (toxic smoke, gas masks).
- Spanish UI and exact meme/chat wording where specified.

## Decisions
- Built as a Vite + Three.js single-page app using procedural low-poly geometry, merged/instanced meshes, no shadows, capped pixel ratio, pooled effects, and adaptive resolution.
- Implemented all 5 mythic weapons, categories, specials, loot, bots, hazards, 3 map variants, skins, minimap, killfeed/chat, pause/end screens, and touch controls.
- Mobile detection via coarse pointer/maxTouchPoints; desktop pointer lock; synthesized gameplay without external art assets.
- Added debug hook `window.__game` in `src/main.js` for testing.
- Game flow: menu → loading → parachute drop → battle → end screen; restart/menu callbacks reuse a single WebGLRenderer.
- Player spawns 38–58 units from one of four curated landmarks (city, village, center, north city edge), excluding the volcano crater, looking toward the landmark.
- Player gets 6 s spawn protection after landing, shown as a HUD chip.
- Game state transitions from `drop` to `playing` on landing.
- Bot pacing slowed: detection range 50, initial fire delay 2–5 s, bot-vs-bot damage ×0.85, bot-vs-bot accuracy ×1.0.
- Lighting tuned down from overexposed (2.15 hemi / 2.5 dir) to per-map boosted values; buildings got emissive lift; neon map got lighter palette, larger windows, corner/roof neon strips and more signs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Project scaffolding, Vite config, all game modules, menu/HUD/end-screen markup and styling.
- Procedural world with terrain, city, village, cordillera, volcano, bunker, neon signs, loot/chicken spots, weather, collision, raycasting.
- Player controller, 29 bots with AI/combat, weapons/specials, hazards (meteors, pigeons, chickens, zone/lava/ash/toxic), pickups, effects, minimap.
- Fixed missing `cone()` helper in `src/world/World.js` that caused `ReferenceError: cone is not defined`.
- Fixed `Game.findSpawn` to accept a `center` landmark and return valid spawn points; added volcano exclusion.
- Fixed spawn protection, state transition, chicken-kill count cap at 10, and stale `window.__game` on menu exit.
- Fixed drop HUD: altitude now updates during descent; duplicate "SALTO EN PARACAÍDAS" banner replaced by altitude-only drop info.
- Menu CSS fixes: horizontal overflow hidden, map card text left-aligned, drop-info moved down, mythic arsenal filler panel added.
- Mobile menu: responsive logo, compact play button, mobile skin selector row; mobile skin selection tested and applies gloves.
- Mobile HUD: pause button no longer clipped, match info hidden, health/weapon panels resized and weapon panel moved above touch controls; `body.is-touch` overrides added for landscape.
- Landscape menu layout fixed so panel no longer overlaps skin row/actions.
- Tested combat (playerShoot hit/damage/kill), pickups, mythic specials, meteor exact chat, pigeon execution, chicken apocalypse, end screen, restart, pause/resume, menu exit, keyboard movement, and firing input.
- Build succeeds (`npm run build`); menu, all three maps, drop/landing, mobile portrait, and mobile landscape render in Playwright.
- No console errors in menu; only a benign llvmpipe WebGL warning.

### Active
- Final visual/UX polish and verification. Latest landscape touch HUD screenshot shows weapon panel correctly moved above touch controls; verify portrait after Vite restart and confirm final desktop flow once more.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Reload and verify final desktop (1280×800) and portrait mobile (390×844) gameplay after the last CSS/server restart, including weapon panel placement and touch controls.
2. Optionally add mobile-only content to fill the empty lower maps-panel area (e.g., hazard/event strip).
3. Run final `npm run build` and a quick console-error check on menu + game.
4. Add `dist/` to `.gitignore`; changes remain uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/src/Game.js`: main orchestrator, spawn/combat/camera/HUD/end logic.
- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/src/world/World.js`: terrain, maps, city/village/volcano, roads/trees, sky, lighting, collisions.
- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/src/systems/Hazards.js`: chickens, meteors, pigeons, zone/lava/toxic, storm wall.
- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/src/entities/Player.js`: player movement, inventory, reload, damage, spawn guard.
- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/src/entities/Bot.js`: bot AI, targeting, shooting, drops.
- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/src/entities/Character.js`: Miguel model, bot meshes, weapon models.
- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/src/systems/Effects.js`: tracers, particles, explosions, beams.
- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/src/ui/HUD.js`: HUD, chat, killfeed, minimap, damage floats, status chips.
- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/src/ui/Menu.js`: map/skin selection and 3D preview.
- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/src/core/Input.js`: keyboard/mouse/touch input.
- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/src/data/weapons.js`: full arsenal and damage values.
- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/src/data/maps.js`: map configs, skins, bot names, chat lines.
- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/src/style.css`: full UI styling, responsive/mobile rules.
- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/src/main.js`: boot, loading, restart/menu flow, debug hook.
- `/home/runner/work/MEME-Shoter/MEME-Shoter/index.html`: menu, HUD, touch controls, end screens markup.

## Important Context
- Dev server runs at `http://localhost:3002` (Vite), restarted after CSS edits; log at `/tmp/opencode/vite.log`.
- Vite sometimes serves stale transformed CSS after edits; restart the server before final verification.
- Playwright CLI is available; use headed Chromium. Screenshots saved in `screenshots/` (ignored by git).
- Headless rendering uses llvmpipe software rendering at ~10 FPS; 57k tris / ~70 draw calls, so FPS readings are not representative of real mobile GPU performance.
- `window.__game` is available after entering a game; it is set to `null` on menu exit.
- Current match pacing: ~0 deaths at 11 s, ~13 deaths by 42 s simulated, ~28 deaths by 110 s simulated.
- Game currently uses 30 total (player + 29 bots); spec's map text mentions 50 participants but section 2 says 30—30 was chosen.
- Changes are uncommitted; no git commit has been made. `dist/` is currently untracked and should be ignored.

1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.
